attractions.name: Hakone Ropeway
attractions.description: Ride above Hakone's volcanic terrain with panoramic views

attractions.name: Owakudani Valley
attractions.description: Active volcanic zone known for sulfur vents and famous black eggs

attractions.name: Hakone Ropeway & Owakudani
attractions.description: Ropeway ride over volcanic landscapes with sulfur vents. Famous for black eggs (kuro tamago) and stunning views of Mt. Fuji (weather permitting).

attractions.name: Lake Ashi Pirate Ship Cruise
attractions.description: Scenic cruise across the lake with views of torii gates and mountains.

local_dishes.name: Kuro Tamago (Black Eggs)
local_dishes.description: Hard-boiled eggs cooked in volcanic hot springs, turning the shell black. Famous at Owakudani.

health_tips.tip: Carry layers when visiting Mt. Fuji and Hakone — weather near Fuji is colder than Tokyo.
